procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
POR and RC did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).

On 17/12/2025 at 17:39hrsPOR filed a scoring inquiry claiming that she was incorrectly scored UFD. The RC’s decision was to make no change to the boat’s score on 17/12/2025 at 18:35hrs. Subsequently, POR filed this request for redress based on the same claim on 17/12/2025 at 18:59hrs.
facts: SI 15.2 says that: A request for redress based on an incident identified in a scoring enquiry will meet the time limit if: 15.2.1 the scoring enquiry was submitted within the time limit specified in RRS 61.2 (b) as changed by SI 15.1; [...]
conclusions: The scoring inquiry was made outside the PTL. POR failed to deliver the request for redress within [the protest time limit, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1).
